sweeps.what: Read the intake column, pick the highest-priority task, move it to doing.
sweeps.on_blocked: leave the task in intake and record the reason

sweeps.what: Walk every task in doing, write a progress line, flag anything with no movement.
sweeps.on_blocked: move the task to review with a blocker note

sweeps.what: Run the redline checks, then decide what may move to done.
sweeps.on_blocked: nothing moves to done; write the failing check to the log

rules.on_repeated_failure: stop sweeping and ask for a human
